context_map.exchanged_information: Locked exchange rate quote, expiry and conversion result.
context_map.boundary_protection: Payments treats the quote as opaque and never computes rates or spreads.

context_map.exchanged_information: Market rates from the rate provider.
context_map.boundary_protection: Provider rate formats are translated into Exchange Rate Quote and Spread Rate.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: FX quote lock and conversion for a cross-border payment
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Quote must be valid (30s lock) when the conversion executes; otherwise a new quote is required.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Rate source and hedging are open questions.
